name: Episode Limit
overview: Stop playback after X files - perfect for falling asleep!
description: Adds a bedtime button to the video player that lets you set how many files to play before automatically stopping. Works with episodes, movies, anything!

versions.changelog: v2.0.0.1 - the popup now stays open and shows the active timer after you choose a limit (close with OK), reopening the moon always shows the current state so you can cancel, edit or re-set it, server replies are read robustly (fixes the popup showing Inactive while a limit was stored), and the moon button now registers with the JavaScript Injector through its documented plugin interface (2.0.0.0's registration failed silently).
